hooks.command:
# check-md-size: warn if CLAUDE.md user content exceeds token threshold
bash ~/.claude/scripts/check-md-size.sh

# check-reread: warn (don't block) if this file was already Read this session
bash ~/.claude/scripts/check-reread.sh

# check-md-size: warn (don't block) if a .md file being read crosses the token threshold
bash ~/.claude/scripts/check-md-size.sh

# context-monitor: periodic automatic context-usage check (every 15 tool calls)
bash ~/.claude/scripts/context-monitor-hook.sh
